justification: Both surfaces carry low relief with animals in profile arranged in horizontal registers bounded by a repeating border band, but the specific content is unrelated: A shows schematic crouching quadrupeds, a large-headed predator or bird, snake-like sinuous forms and abstract net/ladder patterns, while B shows a single naturalistic two-humped pack animal led by a striding human attendant above a band of rosettes. The rendering conventions also differ sharply — A is flat, angular and highly schematic with outline-only bodies, whereas B models musculature, drapery and facial detail naturalistically.
